page: Eden Treaty Legacy documentation for edenTreaty version 1. Recommendation to use treaty (version 2) for new projects. Object-like representation of Elysia server. Types from server directly. Accessors like normal object. No code generation. Error handling with data and error. Type narrowing by status. WebSocket support with subscribe(). File upload with File, FileList, Blob. Questions: Should I use edenTreaty or treaty? How do I handle errors? How do I use WebSocket?

sections.manifest: edenTreaty object-like API. Path transformation: / to . conversion. /path -> .path. /nested/path -> .nested.path. Path parameters: /id/:id -> .id.<anything>. .id['123'] bracket notation. Query with $query parameter. query: { name: 'Eden', code: 'Gold' }. Fetch with $fetch parameter. RequestInit parameters passing. Questions: How do I access routes? How do I use path parameters? How do I add queries?

edenTreaty error handling. data and error destructuring. data null when error. error null when success. error.status HTTP status code. error.value returned error. Status-based narrowing: 400, 401, 500, 502 cases. Type narrowing by status. Both data and error nullable until guard. Type guard for unwrapping. Questions: How do I handle errors? How do I narrow types? What's the error structure?

WebSocket support in edenTreaty. subscribe() method for WebSocket. same API as normal route. message event handler. ws.send() for sending messages. EdenWebSocket extends native WebSocket. Identical WebSocket syntax. EdenWebSocket.raw for native API access. message body and response schema. t.String() for message validation. Questions: How do I use WebSocket? How do I send/receive messages? What's EdenWebSocket?

File upload with edenTreaty. File, FileList, Blob support. Multipart form-data content-type. t.File() for single file. t.Files() for multiple files. Document.getElementById for HTML input. HTMLInputElement.files access. Form field assignment. Questions: How do I upload files? What file types are supported? How do I access form fields?
